policy: Important text should be rendered by UI/data systems above the bitmap. Generated assets intentionally keep signs, labels, forms, notices, and book spines blank or abstract.

editable_regions.suggested_use: Optional diegetic village/route sign, localized outside bitmap.
Optional tiny prop label if needed; better left blank for MVP.
Dialogue clue note or vocabulary prompt rendered as UI overlay.
Do not bake religious or book text into the art; localize separately if ever needed.
Denied-access notice, office hours, or procedural refusal text rendered by UI.
Archive categories or years rendered externally.
Form text, stamp labels, and clue words rendered externally.
